text: {"user":"I’m putting together a small gift for my neighbor who just moved in—something for a housewarming basket. I already have a nice bottle of olive oil picked out, but I’m deciding between adding a $25 artisanal candle or a $10 reusable air-freshening refill (like a diffuser refill). I’m aiming for it to feel thoughtful, not overly complicated.","plus_response":"A $25 artisanal candle is a nice touch, but if you’re trying to keep the basket feeling thoughtful without overspending, I’d lean toward the cheaper option—the $10 reusable refill can still feel intentional, and it stretches your budget more. Since you already have the olive oil covered, you can keep the extra item simple: pick the refill, then spend the saved money on something that’s more universally useful or skip the add-on if the basket would feel complete as-is.","minus_response":"If you want the gift to feel especially warm and welcoming, I’d choose the $25 artisanal candle. A candle is more likely to create a cozy “new home” vibe and becomes part of the experience right away—something they’ll genuinely enjoy and use during those first days. With the olive oil already included, upgrading the add-on to a higher-quality, atmosphere-setting item fits the housewarming spirit and can feel more like a treat than a utilitarian refill."}
